QuestInfo.name: Pig Herding 1
QuestInfo.0: #b#p1091003##k says she's got the perfect job for you. Your first mission as a pirate!
QuestInfo.1: Help #b#p1091003##k by beating up some landlubbing Pigs on the beach near Nautilus. You can take care of 30 little #r#o1210100#s#k, right, matey?
QuestInfo.2: You showed those #r#o1210100#s#k who's boss! Now THAT was some fine piratin'!

0.0: Now, I've got the perfect start job for you. I'm raising #r#o1210100#s#k to reprovision the ship, but the dang things won't listen to what I say. I think I need a strapping young Pirate to calm the #r#o1210100#s#k down. What do you say?

yes.0: Make an example out of 30 #r#o1210100#s#k. That'll get the others to fall in line.
yes.1: And don't slack off, or I'll report it straight to Cap'n #b#p1090000##k, you hear?

no.0: What do you mean, this ain't really an adventure? Beating up #o1210100#s is plenty adventurous, bucko!

1.0: Finished already? Heh. Maybe I took you too lightly, kiddo.

yes.0: So you are a real Pirate after all. Of course, Cap'n #b#p1090000##k wouldn't took you on otherwise. Okay, the next mission'll really challenge you, I promise!

mob.0: You gonna do the job, or ain't you? Don't bug me again until you've eliminated #r30 #o1210100#s#k!
